text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0853 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.30 to C$0.70 lower on follow through selling from Friday's close with technical support expected at C$400 a tonne in the July. Canadian Oilseed Processors' Associaiton weekly crush estimate of 61,268 tonnes of canola seen as bullish but also as an anomally compared to usual crush pace of 45,000 tonnes. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -0.26 Friday from -0.76 Thursday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3760 versus the U.S. dollar, rose to 84.37 Japanese Yen and fell to 1.2271 German Marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.40 down on farmer hedges.

WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.20 to C$0.50 down on good weekend seeding weather, talk South Korea was likely to seek 52,500 tonnes of corn on Tuesday. July-October spread should be offered at even money and bid at C$0.50 under.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 lower on the CWB PRO C$5 to C$6 a tonne cut to wheat on Thursday with contract lows beneath the market as losses should be limited by firm cash demand.
OATS - Steady to US$0.50 down on allied feed grains.
FEED PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 lower after CBOT soymeal closed US$4.00 a ton lower on Friday.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
